notify.missing: {bin} was not found. Build it from linux/nativescreen and put it on PATH.
notify.no-input: Clicks and keys are not recorded: add yourself to the input group to enable auto-zoom from clicks.

allow_window.description: Let the screen picker offer single windows, not only whole screens.
allow_window.label: Allow window capture

auto_zoom.description: Create zooms from clicks when the recording stops.
auto_zoom.label: Auto zoom

binary.description: Command name or full path of the nativescreen recorder.
binary.label: Recorder binary

quality.description: Encoder quantizer from 0 to 51; lower is better quality and larger files.
quality.label: Video quality

typed_keys.description: Store which plain keys were typed, not only that typing happened. Shortcuts are always stored.
typed_keys.label: Record typed keys

tooltip.idle: Record with NativeScreen (right click: choose screen, middle click: open folder)
